newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Livingston, N.J..

text.p: Time and Place of Sale. Proposals will be received by the Chief Financial Officer of the Township of Livingston, in the County of Essex, New Jersey, by hand delivery or fax at the Livingston Municipal Building, 357 South Livingston Avenue, Livingston, New Jersey 07039, fax no. (201) 992- 7531, on

The Bonds. The Bonds will be dated the date of issuance thereof, will mature on February 4, 1998, and will bear interest at the rate per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor in accordance with the Notice of Sale, payable at maturity. The Bonds will be in bearer form without coupons and will be registrable as to principal and interest. The Bonds will be of the denomination of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof, except for one Bond
representing the balance, if any, of the total aggregate principal amount of the Bonds in excess of the nearest such integral multiple. The Bonds will be noncallable.

Bid Specifications. Each proposal must specify a single rate of interest which the Bonds are to bear. The rate so specified shall be in a multiple of one-eighth (1/8) or one- twentieth (1/20) of one percent per annum. Each proposal must state the amount bid for the Bonds, which shall be $2,840,000.

Basis of Award. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder submitting the proposal specifying the lowest rate of interest. As between legally acceptable proposals specifying the same rate of interest, the Bonds will be sold to the bidder complying with the terms of sale and offering to accept for the amount bid the least amount of Bonds, the Bonds so accepted to be in any multiple of $5,000, except for one Bond representing the balance, if any, of the total aggregate principal amount of the Bonds in excess of the nearest such integral multiple. If two or more such bidders offer to accept the same least amount of Bonds, then the Bonds will be sold to the one of such bidders selected by lot from among all of said bidders. The right is hereby reserved to reject all Proposals for Bonds, and so far as permitted by law, to waive any irregularities or

Additional Information. The Bonds will be issued subject to the approving legal opinion of Wolff & Samson, P.A., Bond Counsel. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the full Notice of Sale and the Proposal for Bonds may be obtained from the Chief Financial Officer of the Township,
357 South Livingston Avenue, Livingston, New Jersey (telephone (201) 535-7973).
*Subject to adjustment in accordance with the Notice of Sale
